quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Prologue

dialogue.t: Hello! Excuse me, outlander. Could you hear me out?
Please don't linger on this island for too long. Recently, the Tatarigami's reach has spread wider and wider.
Yes, since the people from Sangonomiya destroyed the ward that suppressed the soul of the serpent god, the Tatarigami has spread across the island...
As you can see, the sky is now perpetually clouded and the rain won't stop. This is all because of the Tatarigami.
Recently, one by one all the miners have fallen ill, gone insane, or fled to other islands...
Everyone's gone. There's hardly anyone living on this island anymore.
Ironically, due to the chaos created by the Tatarigami, the Shogunate and the rebels have not been fighting over this place quite as hard.
Hmph! But if they had not destroyed our great Ogosho's ward, the island wouldn't have become such a mess in the first place!
What do the Commissions or dragons or serpents have to do with me, huh? They never asked my opinion before starting their cursed war!

dialogue.sit: Then why are you still here?

dialogue.t: Why? Because this is my home.
They are in a safe place, but thanks for your concern. They must be waiting for me to bring them back here.
No one on the island left voluntarily. We are a family here. Anywhere else we go, we'll have to work for someone else.
But someone had to stay and clean up the mess so that everyone else can return home eventually.
*sigh* This is such a headache...

dialogue.sit: Is there anything I can help with?

dialogue.t: If it were any other child offering to help me out of the blue, I'd be laughing out loud right now...
But seeing as you're a traveler from afar who has managed to venture this deep into Inazuma, you must certainly be able to hold your own.
I'll get straight to the point, then. The ward over there has been bothering me for a long time, maybe you could find a way to repair it?
I'm sure that this awful weather can only be due to the wards' destruction.
But please, be careful when you approach the ward. If you stare at it, it will release a burst of energy towards you...
It's harmless, but very uncomfortable. It feels like it's... rejecting you.
I think the ward is missing some components. It can probably be fixed by putting the missing parts back.
Of course, that's just speculation on my part. I still can't say for sure what's gone wrong.
So, if you want to help, please help me fix this ward.
But if you can't manage it, then like I was saying — don't stick around here too long.

quests.description: Yashiori Island is deep in the throes of the Tatarigami’s effects. Still, a miner named Kaji remains on the island, seemingly searching for a way to inhibit the corruption’s proliferation…
